name: 4M Metals - by Sentrigard
old_description: fabrication experts in the Low Country and surrounding areas.
about:
4M Metals, based in Ridgeland, South Carolina, was established in September 2006. The company operates as a supplier and fabricator of metal roofing components for the Low Country region, including Beaufort and Savannah.

The shop runs modern computerized folding and shearing machines alongside panel roll formers, enabling in-house production of custom trim flashing packages and on-site panel fabrication. The facility stocks over 35 colors in materials such as painted galvalume, aluminum, stainless steel, and copper, and serves both commercial and residential roofing projects as well as flat-roof applications. Staff experience totals more than 50 years in metal roofing and sheet metal fabrication.

Customers range from roofing contractors and construction firms to homeowners across the Low Country and coastal areas. The company also fabricates related items such as chimney caps, windscreens, HVAC ductwork, countertop wraps, backsplashes, cupolas, louvers, and full building-envelope flashing. It holds manufacturer certifications for coastal-climate metal performance and assists clients in locating qualified installers.

4M Metals emphasizes its investment in up-to-date forming technology, quick turnaround on custom flashing, and a combined 75-plus years of hands-on fabrication knowledge among its team as factors that distinguish its service in the region.
